name: Logs Explore UI bug
reason: This is a SaaS Explore/Logs UI bug: the 1H refresh action updates the log table but leaves the chart stale. No SDK or self-hosted-specific behavior is involved, and there is no transfer history indicating ownership elsewhere.

name: Insufficient information
reason: The issue contains only a title and a French greeting; it provides no identifiable failure mode, environment, reproduction steps, or indication of repository ownership. There is no basis for routing to an SDK or self-hosted repository.

name: Previously disputed ownership
reason: The issue affects Sentry's server-side event pipeline: a misconfigured internal DSN triggers recursive error handling, worker panics, and blocks ingestion. It is not sufficiently established as a Python SDK-only defect. Self-hosted and sentry-python ownership were both attempted; the issue was returned to getsentry/sentry, and a maintainer explicitly said the cascade was not fully understood and passed it back.
